purpose: Blinded source judgment of eight connected Fuhan campaign claims; no proposed operations or desired verdicts included
question: Judge event ownership and whether existing chronology accurately expresses what is known. Read all Chinese including inherited accession context, current campaign, and quoted historical precedents. A supported one-sided bound is permissible; preserve unresolved source-period, identity, conversion or endpoint conflicts. Do not infer exact years, reign/lifespan intervals, or convert living events to retrospective reception. Return independent source-specific judgment for every selected claim.

units.zh: 駿子重華
units.en: Zhang Chonghua, Zhang Jun’s heir
units.literal: Son of Jun: Chonghua

units.zh: =重華字泰臨，駿之第二子也。
units.en: Zhang Chonghua, courtesy name Tailin, was the second son.
units.literal: = Chonghua, courtesy name Tailin, was Jun’s second son.

units.zh: 寬和懿重，沈毅少言。
units.en: He was gentle, grave, and taciturn.
units.literal: He was generous, mild, stately, and weighty, deep and resolute and seldom speaking.

units.zh: 父卒，時年十六。
units.en: He was sixteen when his father died.
units.literal: When his father died he was sixteen years of age.

units.zh: 以永和二年自稱持節、大都督、太尉、護羌校尉、涼州牧、西平公、假涼王，赦其境內。
units.en: In the second year of Yonghe he took the staff, grand governorship, grand commandant, Qiang colonelcy, Liangzhou shepherd, ducal title, and acting kingship of Liang, then amnestied the province.
units.literal: In the second year of Yonghe he styled himself bearer of credentials, grand governor, grand commandant, Colonel Who Protects the Qiang, governor of Liangzhou, Duke of Xiping, and acting King of Liang, and declared an amnesty within his borders.

units.zh: 尊其母嚴氏為太王太后，居永訓宮；
units.en: He elevated Lady Yan to grand queen dowager in Yongxun Palace.
units.literal: He honored his mother Lady Yan as grand king dowager, dwelling in the Yongxun Palace;

units.zh: 所生母馬氏為王太后，居永壽宮。
units.en: He elevated his mother Lady Ma to queen dowager in Yongshou Palace.
units.literal: His birth mother Lady Ma was made queen dowager, dwelling in the Yongshou Palace.

units.zh: 輕賦斂，除關稅，省園囿，以恤貧窮。
units.en: Zhang Chonghua cut taxes, lifted tolls, shrank court parks, and steered relief to the destitute.
units.literal: He lightened taxes and levies, abolished transit duties, reduced park and garden expenses, and thereby gave relief to the poor.

units.zh: 遣使奉章于石季龍。
units.en: He dispatched a memorial to Shi Hu, styled Jilong.
units.literal: He sent envoys presenting a memorial to Shi Jilong.

units.zh: 季龍使王擢、麻秋、孫伏都等侵寇不輟。
units.en: Shi Hu answered with Wang Zhuo, Ma Qiu, and Sun Fudu in relentless border raids.
units.literal: Jilong sent Wang Zhuo, Ma Qiu, Sun Fudu, and others to raid and invade without cease.

units.zh: 金城太守張沖降於秋。
units.en: Jincheng’s Zhang Chong went over to Ma Qiu.
units.literal: Grand Administrator of Jincheng Zhang Chong surrendered to Ma Qiu.

units.zh: 於是涼州振動。
units.en: Panic swept the province.
units.literal: Thereupon Liangzhou was shaken.

units.zh: 重華掃境內，使其征南將軍裴恆禦之。
units.en: Zhang Chonghua mobilized the province and sent Pei Heng, general who conquers the south, to meet the threat.
units.literal: Chonghua swept the territory within his borders and sent his General Who Conquers the South Pei Heng to oppose them.

units.zh: 恆壁于廣武，欲以持久弊之。
units.en: Pei Heng fortified Guangwu, planning to exhaust the foe by stalemate.
units.literal: Heng walled at Guangwu, intending by long delay to wear the enemy down.

units.zh: 牧府相司馬張耽言于重華曰：「臣聞國以兵為強，以將為主。
units.en: Marshal Zhang Dan told him: “A state’s strength is its army; its heart is its generals.
units.literal: Marshal of the shepherd’s headquarters Zhang Dan said to Chonghua, ‘Your servant has heard that the state is strong through arms and rests on its generals.

units.zh: 主將者，存亡之機，吉凶所系。
units.en: The supreme commander decides whether the realm stands or falls.
units.literal: The commander-in-chief is the pivot of survival or loss, to which good and ill attach.

units.zh: 故燕任樂毅，克平全齊，及任騎劫，喪七十城之地。
units.en: Yan used Yue Yi and conquered Qi; with Qi Jie it lost seventy towns.
units.literal: Therefore Yan employed Yue Yi and was able to pacify all Qi; when it employed Qi Jia, it lost seventy cities.

units.zh: 是以古之明君靡不慎於將相也。
units.en: Wise kings always picked commanders with care.
units.literal: Thus enlightened kings of old were never careless in choosing generals and ministers.

units.zh: 今之所要，在於軍師。
units.en: Today the crucial post is chief strategist.
units.literal: What matters now is the army’s strategist.

units.zh: 然議者舉將多推宿舊，未必妙盡精才也。
units.en: Counselors keep naming old faces who may not be the best talents.
units.literal: Yet those who debate raising generals mostly push aged veterans, not necessarily men who exhaust the finest talent.

units.zh: 且韓信之舉，非舊名也；
units.en: Han Xin had no prior fame when taken up;
units.literal: Moreover Han Xin’s elevation was not an old reputation;

units.zh: 穰宜之信，非舊將也；
units.en: Rang Ju was no longtime commander when trusted;
units.literal: Rang Ju’s trust was not an old general;

units.zh: 呂蒙之進，非舊勳也；
units.en: Lü Meng was not promoted for past laurels;
units.literal: Lü Meng’s promotion was not for old merit;

units.zh: 魏延之用，非舊德也。
units.en: Wei Yan was not chosen for old kindness.
units.literal: Wei Yan’s use was not for old virtue.

units.zh: 蓋明王之舉，舉無常人，才之所能，則授以大事。
units.en: Great kings assign great tasks purely on talent.
units.literal: In general the enlightened king’s choice has no fixed person—wherever talent reaches, there he entrusts the great task.

units.zh: 今強寇在郊，諸將不進，人情騷動，危機稍逼。
units.en: With the enemy at the gate and armies idle, the people panicked.
units.literal: Now a strong foe presses the border; the generals do not advance; popular feeling is restless and crisis draws near.

units.zh: 主簿謝艾，兼資文武，明識兵略，若授以斧鉞，委以專征，必能折沖禦侮，殲殄凶類。」
units.en: Chief clerk Xie Ai, both scholar and soldier, could shatter the invasion if given independent command.”
units.literal: Chief clerk Xie Ai combines civil and martial gifts, understands strategy—if you give him the axe and halberd and entrust him with sole command, he is sure to break charges, repel insult, and wipe out the villains.’

units.zh: 重華召艾，問以討寇方略。
units.en: Zhang Chonghua called Xie Ai in for a war plan.
units.literal: Chonghua summoned Ai and asked him for plans to punish the foe.

units.zh: 艾曰：「昔耿弇不欲以賊遺君父，黃權願以萬人當寇。
units.en: Ai said, ‘In olden times Geng Yan did not wish to leave bandits for his lord and father; Huang Quan was willing with ten thousand men to face the foe.
units.literal: Ai said, ‘In olden times Geng Yan did not wish to leave bandits for his lord and father; Huang Quan was willing with ten thousand men to face the foe.

units.zh: 乞假臣兵七千，為殿下吞王擢、麻秋等。」
units.en: He asked for seven thousand men to destroy Wang Zhuo and Ma Qiu.”
units.literal: I beg to borrow seven thousand troops for your highness to swallow Wang Zhuo, Ma Qiu, and the rest.’

units.zh: 重華大悅，以艾為中堅將軍，配步騎五千擊秋。
units.en: Zhang Chonghua made him central-rampart general with five thousand to hit Ma Qiu.
units.literal: Chonghua was greatly pleased, appointed Ai as General of the Central Rampart, and assigned him five thousand foot and horse to strike Ma Qiu.

units.zh: 引師出振武，夜有二梟鳴於牙中，艾曰：「梟，邀也，六博得梟者勝。
units.en: He led the army out from Zhenwu; at night two owls cried in the headquarters; Ai said, ‘The owl is “invite”; in the six sticks game he who throws the owl wins.
units.literal: He led the army out from Zhenwu; at night two owls cried in the headquarters; Ai said, ‘The owl is “invite”; in the six sticks game he who throws the owl wins.

units.zh: 今梟鳴牙中，克敵之兆。」
units.en: Now the owl cries in the headquarters—an omen of crushing the enemy."
units.literal: Now the owl cries in the headquarters—an omen of crushing the enemy.

units.zh: 於是進戰，大破之，斬首五千級。
units.en: He attacked and routed them, taking five thousand heads.
units.literal: Thereupon he advanced to battle, inflicted a great defeat, and beheaded five thousand ranks.

units.zh: 重華封艾為福祿伯，善待之。
units.en: Zhang Chonghua ennobled him as count of Fulu and favored him.
units.literal: Chonghua enfeoffed Ai as Earl of Fulu and treated him well.

units.zh: 諸寵貴惡其賢，共毀譖之，乃出為酒泉太守。
units.en: Court favorites envied him and had him posted away to Jiuquan.
units.literal: The various favorites hated his worth and together slandered him; he was therefore sent out as grand administrator of Jiuquan.

units.zh: 季龍又令麻秋進陷大夏，大夏護軍梁式執太守宋晏，以城應秋。
units.en: Shi Hu sent Ma Qiu to take Daxia; its protector seized the governor and surrendered.
units.literal: Jilong again ordered Ma Qiu to advance and capture Daxia; Protector of Daxia Liang Shi seized Grand Administrator Song Yan and opened the city to Ma Qiu.

units.zh: 秋遣晏以書誘宛戍都尉宋矩。
units.en: Ma Qiu used Song Yan to lure Wanshu’s commandant Song Ju.
units.literal: Qiu sent Yan with a letter to entice Garrison Commandant of Wanshu Song Ju.

units.zh: 宋矩謂秋曰：「辭父事君，當立功義；
units.en: Song Ju said to Ma Qiu, ‘Leaving father to serve a lord, one ought to establish merit and righteousness;
units.literal: Song Ju said to Ma Qiu, ‘Leaving father to serve a lord, one ought to establish merit and righteousness;

units.zh: 功義不立，當守名節。
units.en: without achievement, a man still keeps his good name.
units.literal: if merit and righteousness are not established, one ought to guard name and integrity.

units.zh: 矩終不肯主偷生於世。」
units.en: Ju will in the end not consent to live basely in the world."
units.literal: Ju will in the end not consent to live basely in the world.

units.zh: 於是先殺妻子，自刎而死。
units.en: He slew his family and cut his own throat.
units.literal: Thereupon he first killed wife and children, then cut his own throat and died.

units.zh: 是月，有司議遣司兵趙長迎秋西郊。
units.en: Officials proposed welcoming Ma Qiu outside the west gate.
units.literal: That month the offices debated sending Army Officer Zhao Chang to welcome Ma Qiu west of the suburbs.

units.zh: 謝艾以《春秋》之義，國有大喪，省蒐狩之禮，宜待逾年。
units.en: Xie Ai cited the Annals: great mourning cancels hunts—wait a year.
units.literal: Xie Ai, citing the Spring and Autumn Annals’ meaning that when the state has great mourning hunting rites are reduced, said they ought to wait more than a year.

units.zh: 別駕從事索遐議曰：「禮，天子崩，諸侯薨，末殯，五祀不行，既殯而行之。
units.en: Chief clerk Suo Xia argued, ‘By the rites, when the Son of Heaven dies the feudal lords wail—before the end of the fifth sacrifice, the five household sacrifices are not performed; after the end of wailing they are performed.
units.literal: Chief clerk Suo Xia argued, ‘By the rites, when the Son of Heaven dies the feudal lords wail—before the end of the fifth sacrifice, the five household sacrifices are not performed; after the end of wailing they are performed.

units.zh: 魯宣三年，天王崩，不廢郊祀。
units.en: Lu kept suburban sacrifice when the Zhou king died.
units.literal: In the third year of Duke Xuan of Lu the king of heaven died, yet suburban sacrifice was not halted.

units.zh: 今聖上統承大位，百揆惟新，宜在璿璣玉衡以齊七政。
units.en: The new ruler should align heaven and earth with the seven luminaries.
units.literal: Now the sage lord has inherited the great position and the hundred affairs are anew—it is fitting to align the seven powers with the jade armillary.

units.zh: 立秋，萬物將成，殺氣之始，其于王事，杖麾誓眾，釁鼓禮神，所以討逆除暴，成功濟務，寧宗廟社稷，致天下之福，不可廢也。」
units.en: Autumn rites for war against rebels must proceed.”
units.literal: At the beginning of autumn the myriad things are about to mature; killing qi begins; for kingly affairs, leaning on the staff, swearing the host, smearing the drums and sacrificing to the spirits are how one punishes rebels, removes violence, completes merit, aids the task, quiets the altars of soil and grain, and brings blessing to all under heaven—it cannot be abandoned.’

units.zh: 重華從之。
units.en: Zhang Chonghua agreed.
units.literal: Chonghua followed this.

units.zh: 俄而麻秋進攻枹罕，時晉陽太守郎坦以城大難守，宜棄外城。
units.en: Ma Qiu besieged Fuhan; Lang Tan of Jinyang wanted to abandon the outer wall.
units.literal: Before long Ma Qiu advanced to attack Fuhan; at that time grand administrator of Jinyang Lang Tan thought the city too large to defend and that the outer wall ought to be abandoned.

units.zh: 武城太守張悛曰：「棄外城則大事去矣，不可以動眾心。」
units.en: Grand Administrator of Wucheng Zhang Quan said, "If we abandon the outer wall the great task is lost—it cannot be done without shaking the host’s hearts."
units.literal: Grand Administrator of Wucheng Zhang Quan said, ‘If we abandon the outer wall the great task is lost—it cannot be done without shaking the host’s hearts.

units.zh: 甯戎校尉張璩從之，固守大城。
units.en: Colonel Zhang Qu agreed and held the main citadel.
units.literal: Colonel Who Pacifies the Rong Zhang Qu followed this and firmly defended the great city.

units.zh: 秋率眾八萬，圍塹數重，雲梯雹車，地突百道，皆通於內。
units.en: Ma Qiu brought eighty thousand, trenches, ladders, siege towers, and saps.
units.literal: Qiu led eighty thousand men, rings of trenches layer on layer, cloud ladders and hailstone carts, a hundred underground saps—all connected within.

units.zh: 城中亦應之，殺傷秋眾已數萬。
units.en: The defenders killed tens of thousands of his troops.
units.literal: The city answered in kind and had already killed or wounded tens of thousands of Qiu’s men.

units.zh: 季龍復遣其將劉渾等率步騎二萬會之。
units.en: Shi Hu reinforced him with Liu Hun and twenty thousand men.
units.literal: Jilong again sent his general Liu Hun and others with twenty thousand foot and horse to join him.

units.zh: 郎坦恨言之不從，教軍士李嘉潛與秋通，引賊千餘人上城西北隅。
units.en: Lang Tan betrayed the city, smuggling Ma Qiu’s men onto the wall.
units.literal: Lang Tan resented that his words were not followed and instructed the soldier Li Jia secretly to communicate with Ma Qiu, leading more than a thousand bandits onto the northwest corner of the wall.

units.zh: 璩使宋修、張弘、辛挹、郭普距之，短兵接戰，斬二百餘人，賊乃退。
units.en: Zhang Qu’s officers drove the breach force back, killing two hundred.
units.literal: Qu sent Song Xiu, Zhang Hong, Xin Yi, and Guo Pu to oppose them; fighting at close quarters they beheaded more than two hundred and the bandits then withdrew.

units.zh: 璩戮李嘉以徇，燒其攻具。
units.en: Zhang Qu executed Li Jia and torched the siege gear.
units.literal: Qu executed Li Jia as a warning and burned the assault engines.

units.zh: 秋退保大夏，謂諸將曰：「我用兵於五都之間，攻城掠地，往無不捷。
units.en: Qiu withdrew to hold Daxia and said to his generals, ‘I have used troops among the five capitals, stormed cities and seized land—wherever I went there was no failure.
units.literal: Qiu withdrew to hold Daxia and said to his generals, ‘I have used troops among the five capitals, stormed cities and seized land—wherever I went there was no failure.

units.zh: 及登秦隴，謂有征無戰。
units.en: He had expected the northwest to fall easily.
units.literal: When I mounted Qin and Long I thought there would be expeditions without battles.

units.zh: 豈悟南襲仇池，破軍殺將；
units.en: Southward at Chouchi he had lost generals;
units.literal: Who would have thought that striking south at Chouchi I would break armies and lose generals;

units.zh: 築城長最，匹馬不歸；
units.en: at Changzui not one horse came home;
units.literal: that building the wall at Changzui not a single horse returned;

units.zh: 及攻此城，傷兵挫銳。
units.en: Fuhan had bloodied his veterans.
units.literal: and that attacking this city would wound soldiers and blunt keen edges.

units.zh: 殆天所贊，非人力也。」
units.en: This is almost Heaven’s aid, not human power.’
units.literal: This is almost Heaven’s aid, not human power.’

units.zh: 季龍聞而歎曰：「吾以偏師定九州，今以九州之力困於枹罕，真所謂彼有人焉，未可圖也。」
units.en: When Jilong heard this he sighed and said, ‘I with a partial army settled the nine provinces; now with the strength of nine provinces I am exhausted at Fuhan—this is truly what they call “they have men there—it cannot be plotted against.”’
units.literal: When Jilong heard this he sighed and said, ‘I with a partial army settled the nine provinces; now with the strength of nine provinces I am exhausted at Fuhan—this is truly what they call “they have men there—it cannot be plotted against.”’

units.zh: 重華以謝艾為使持節、軍師將軍，率步騎三萬，進軍臨河。
units.en: Zhang Chonghua gave Xie Ai the staff as army supervisor with thirty thousand men to the Yellow River.
units.literal: Chonghua appointed Xie Ai as bearer of credentials and Army Supervisor General, leading thirty thousand foot and horse to advance to the river.

units.zh: 秋以三萬眾距之。
units.en: Ma Qiu met him with thirty thousand.
units.literal: Qiu opposed him with thirty thousand.

units.zh: 艾乘軺車，冠白帢，鳴鼓而行。
units.en: Xie Ai rode a light wagon in a white cap, drums rolling.
units.literal: Ai rode in a light cart, wore a white kerchief, and advanced beating drums.

units.zh: 秋望而怒曰：「艾年少書生，冠服如此，輕我也。」
units.en: Qiu saw from afar and angrily said, ‘Ai is a young student; such cap and dress—he despises me."
units.literal: Qiu saw from afar and angrily said, ‘Ai is a young student; such cap and dress—he despises me.

units.zh: 命黑槊龍驤三千人馳擊之。
units.en: He sent three thousand elite lancers to charge.
units.literal: He ordered three thousand black-lance dragon chargers to gallop and strike them.

units.zh: 艾左右大擾。
units.en: Xie Ai’s staff panicked.
units.literal: Ai’s attendants were greatly alarmed.

units.zh: 左戰帥李偉勸艾乘馬，艾不從，乃下車踞胡床，指麾處分。
units.en: Li Wei begged him to mount; Xie Ai sat on a camp stool and commanded seated.
units.literal: Left battle commander Li Wei urged Ai to mount a horse; Ai did not follow, but got down from the cart, sat cross-legged on a folding stool, and directed disposition.

units.zh: 賊以為伏兵發也，懼不敢進。
units.en: The foe thought an ambush had fired and hesitated.
units.literal: The bandits thought ambush troops had sprung and feared to advance.

units.zh: 張瑁從左南緣河而截其後，秋軍乃退。
units.en: Zhang Mao swung from the left along the river and severed Ma Qiu’s retreat; Ma Qiu pulled back.
units.literal: Zhang Mao from the left south followed the river and cut off their rear; Qiu’s army then withdrew.

units.zh: 艾乘勝奔擊，遂大敗之，斬秋將杜勳、汲魚，俘斬一萬三級，秋匹馬奔大夏。
units.en: Xie Ai routed him, slew Du Xun and Ji Yu, took thirteen thousand heads, and drove Ma Qiu alone to Daxia.
units.literal: Ai pursued with victory and inflicted a great rout, beheading Qiu’s generals Du Xun and Ji Yu, capturing or beheading thirteen thousand ranks, and Qiu fled on a single horse to Daxia.

units.zh: 重華論功，以謝艾為太府左長史，進封福祿縣伯，邑五千戶，帛八千匹。
units.en: Zhang Chonghua raised him to left chief clerk of the grand treasury, count of Fulu with five thousand households and eight thousand bolts of silk.
units.literal: Chonghua assessed merit and appointed Xie Ai as left chief clerk of the grand treasury, advanced his fief to County Earl of Fulu with five thousand households and eight thousand bolts of silk.

units.zh: 麻秋又據枹罕，有眾十二萬，進屯河內，遣王擢略地晉興、廣武，越洪池嶺，至於曲柳，姑臧大震。
units.en: Ma Qiu again held Fuhan with a host of one hundred twenty thousand, advanced and encamped south of the river, sent Wang Zhuo to raid Jinxing and Guangwu, crossed Hongchi Ridge as far as Quliu, and Guzang was greatly shaken.
units.literal: Ma Qiu again held Fuhan with a host of one hundred twenty thousand, advanced and encamped south of the river, sent Wang Zhuo to raid Jinxing and Guangwu, crossed Hongchi Ridge as far as Quwillow, and Guzang was greatly shaken.

units.zh: 重華議欲親出距之，謝艾固諫以為不可。
units.en: Zhang Chonghua meant to lead in person; Xie Ai forbade it.
units.literal: Chonghua debated wishing to go out in person to oppose him; Xie Ai firmly remonstrated that it could not be done.
